description: This file defines the AzureQueueBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for handling batches of stream events in Azure Queue storage within the Orleans framework. It manages event sequences, request contexts, and provides methods to retrieve events and import request context data.

classes.name: AzureQueueBatchContainer
classes.description: An internal class that encapsulates a batch of stream events for Azure Queue storage, including sequence tokens and request context management.

methods.name: AzureQueueBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with stream ID, events, request context, and sequence token.

methods.name: AzureQueueBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the batch container with stream ID, events, and request context, without sequence token.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the events of a specified type along with their sequence tokens.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the stored request context into the current execution context.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container, including stream ID and item count.
